characters.description: An outworlder adventurer who leads a six-person team in Greenstone. He protects his companions and hopes to find a route back to his own world.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: A prince whose experienced adventuring team trains against Jason's group.
characters.name: Valdis

characters.description: A swift close-combat adventurer training with Jason's team. Her indenture to Jason remains part of her circumstances at the start of the book.
characters.name: Sophie Wexler

characters.description: A shapeshifting support fighter on Jason's team and an intermittent student of Clive.
characters.name: Belinda

characters.description: An experienced frontline member of Jason's team. He combines disciplined combat training with a strong sense of responsibility.
characters.name: Humphrey Geller

characters.description: The team's specialist in ritual and astral magic. His expertise supports the group's magical research and field work.
characters.name: Clive Standish

characters.description: The team's healer, defender, and support specialist. His shields and protective abilities keep companions functioning through difficult training and compensate when the group makes tactical mistakes.
characters.name: Neil Davone

characters.description: Jason's mentor and one of the friends who first helped him in this world. He supports the team's training while mourning Farrah and recovering from the Builder Cult's island attack.
characters.name: Rufus Remore

characters.description: A leonid weaponsmith and trusted ally of Jason's group. He contributes equipment and practical support while carrying the loss of Farrah.
characters.name: Gary

characters.description: A deceased former teammate whose loss continues to shape Rufus, Gary, and the wider group after the island raid.
characters.name: Farrah

characters.description: An alchemist and healer who is Belinda's partner.
characters.name: Jory Tillman

characters.description: A powerful patron who supports Jason's associates and research into the sealed astral space.
characters.name: Emir

characters.description: Greenstone's Adventure Society director.
characters.name: Elspeth Arella

characters.description: An Old City power broker.
characters.name: Adris Dorgan

characters.description: A silver-rank adventurer of the Geller family.
characters.name: Danielle Geller

characters.description: Jason's former partner and Thadwick's sister.
characters.name: Cassandra Mercer

characters.description: Thadwick's mother and a senior member of the Mercer family, still tied to the consequences of her son's involvement with the Builder Cult.
characters.name: Thalia Mercer

characters.description: A compromised member of the Mercer family connected to Builder Cult activity.
characters.name: Thadwick Mercer

characters.description: A Greenstone crime lord who claims control over Sophie and regards Jason's interference as a direct challenge to his authority.
characters.name: Cole Silva

characters.description: A Magic Society official hostile to Jason and Sophie. His institutional position and knowledge of magical evidence make his opposition especially dangerous.
characters.name: Lucian Lamprey

characters.description: A priestess of Purity.
characters.name: Anisa Lasalle

characters.description: Jason's shadow familiar and a guide to Reaper knowledge. Multiple bodies support Jason's movement and reconnaissance.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: Jason's force-beam familiar. Gordon supports the team with disruptive ranged attacks.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: Jason's healing familiar.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: Humphrey's small dragon familiar. Stash assists the team through transformation magic.
characters.name: Stash

characters.description: A priestess of the Goddess of Knowledge and Humphrey's former lover. She brings Jason a collection on matters beyond the world, personally prepared through her goddess's direction.
characters.name: Gabrielle Pellin

characters.description: A member of Valdis's adventuring team who participates in its training matches against Jason's group.
characters.name: Sigrid Frayn

characters.description: The Archbishop of Purity, absent on an unexplained sabbatical while other churches investigate Purity clergy for cooperation with the Builder Cult.
characters.name: Nicholas Hendren

characters.description: Humphrey's sister and the bronze-rank supervisor assigned to Jason's road-contract team. She is an experienced minion specialist responsible for judging when the iron-rank group must yield to her.
characters.name: Henrietta Geller

characters.description: The surviving silver-rank leader of the Builder Cult's local force. From the former Vane estate, he oversees a portal operation intended to reclaim the sealed astral space.
characters.name: Zato

characters.description: A Builder Cult operative responsible for security and portal preparations at the concealed Vane-estate base.
characters.name: Timos

characters.description: The distant power behind the cult's effort to build an astral bridge into the sealed space. Its followers' plan threatens Greenstone and the surrounding region.
characters.name: the Builder

characters.description: Clive's tortoise familiar. Its elemental powers can be repeatedly replenished by Clive.
characters.name: Onslow

characters.description: Cole Silva's highly capable abduction specialist, skilled in ritual magic and bone conjuration. He helps arrange Jason's covert capture at a site prepared to defeat ordinary tracking.
characters.name: Killian Laurent

characters.description: A gold-rank priest of the Church of the Healer who specializes in soul trauma and starseed cases. He examines Jason to determine whether the implantation left any Builder influence behind.
characters.name: Carlos Quilido

characters.description: A researcher investigating Sophie's unknown family background and the assassin-order inheritance taught by Sophie's father.
characters.name: Emilia

characters.description: A former Blood Cult member who once released Anisa from captivity and has since attached himself to the Builder Cult's operation beneath the Vane estate.
characters.name: Dougall

characters.description: A dangerous creature that escapes from the opened astral space. Its presence is recognized after portal guards are found drained of magic.
characters.name: Energy vampire

characters.description: A diamond-rank servant through whom the Builder can speak. He is also the distant founder of an imperial line whose descendants possess Builder-made guardian golems.
characters.name: Shako

characters.description: Jason's sister on Earth and a publicly known celebrity chef. A former detective gives her material concerning the suppressed investigation into her brother's disappearance.
characters.name: Erika Asano

characters.description: The investigator assigned to the impossible disappearance of a section of Jason's Melbourne apartment building. He loses his position after resisting official pressure to accept a false explanation.
characters.name: Adam Cosgrove

characters.description: A recruiter from an organization opposed to keeping the hidden truth from the public. He offers the former detective a demonstration before asking for any commitment.
characters.name: Dash

characters.description: The peak diamond-rank First Servant of the Cult of the World Phoenix. She temporarily delegates her duties while undertaking an assignment connected to the Outworlder.
characters.name: Dawn

characters.description: A draconian diamond-ranker and Dawn's intended successor. She temporarily assumes the First Servant's duties while Dawn tests whether she is ready to make independent decisions.
characters.name: Helsveth
